# dbx

Types from the Go package `dbx` (a library PocketBase builds on), as JavaScript sees them: they turn up as values of [PocketBase's types](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase) and of hook events.

## dbx.Builder

Builder supports building SQL statements in a DB-agnostic way.
Builder mainly provides two sets of query building methods: those building SELECT statements
and those manipulating DB data or schema (e.g. INSERT statements, CREATE TABLE statements).

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `newQuery()` | <code>(_arg0: string): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxquery">Query</a>)</code> | NewQuery creates a new Query object with the given SQL statement. The SQL statement may contain parameter placeholders which can be bound with actual parameter values before the statement is executed. |
| `select()` | <code>(..._arg0: string[]): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxselectquery">SelectQuery</a>)</code> | Select returns a new SelectQuery object that can be used to build a SELECT statement. The parameters to this method should be the list column names to be selected. A column name may have an optional alias name. For example, Select("id", "my_name AS name"). |
| `model()` | <code>(_arg0: { }): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxmodelquery">ModelQuery</a>)</code> | ModelQuery returns a new ModelQuery object that can be used to perform model insertion, update, and deletion. The parameter to this method should be a pointer to the model struct that needs to be inserted, updated, or deleted. |
| `generatePlaceholder()` | <code>(_arg0: number): string</code> | GeneratePlaceholder generates an anonymous parameter placeholder with the given parameter ID. |
| `quote()` | <code>(_arg0: string): string</code> | Quote quotes a string so that it can be embedded in a SQL statement as a string value. |
| `quoteSimpleTableName()` | <code>(_arg0: string): string</code> | QuoteSimpleTableName quotes a simple table name. A simple table name does not contain any schema prefix. |
| `quoteSimpleColumnName()` | <code>(_arg0: string): string</code> | QuoteSimpleColumnName quotes a simple column name. A simple column name does not contain any table prefix. |
| `queryBuilder()` | <code>(): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxquerybuilder">QueryBuilder</a></code> | QueryBuilder returns the query builder supporting the current DB. |
| `insert()` | <code>(table: string, cols: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxparams">Params</a>): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxquery">Query</a>)</code> | Insert creates a Query that represents an INSERT SQL statement. The keys of cols are the column names, while the values of cols are the corresponding column values to be inserted. |
| `upsert()` | <code>(table: string, cols: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxparams">Params</a>, ...constraints: string[]): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxquery">Query</a>)</code> | Upsert creates a Query that represents an UPSERT SQL statement. Upsert inserts a row into the table if the primary key or unique index is not found. Otherwise it will update the row with the new values. The keys of cols are the column names, while the values of cols are the corresponding column values to be inserted. |
| `update()` | <code>(table: string, cols: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxparams">Params</a>, where: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxexpression">Expression</a>): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxquery">Query</a>)</code> | Update creates a Query that represents an UPDATE SQL statement. The keys of cols are the column names, while the values of cols are the corresponding new column values. If the "where" expression is nil, the UPDATE SQL statement will have no WHERE clause (be careful in this case as the SQL statement will update ALL rows in the table). |
| `delete()` | <code>(table: string, where: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxexpression">Expression</a>): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxquery">Query</a>)</code> | Delete creates a Query that represents a DELETE SQL statement. If the "where" expression is nil, the DELETE SQL statement will have no WHERE clause (be careful in this case as the SQL statement will delete ALL rows in the table). |
| `createTable()` | <code>(table: string, cols: { [key: string]: any }, ...options: string[]): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxquery">Query</a>)</code> | CreateTable creates a Query that represents a CREATE TABLE SQL statement. The keys of cols are the column names, while the values of cols are the corresponding column types. The optional "options" parameters will be appended to the generated SQL statement. |
| `renameTable()` | <code>(oldName: string, newName: string): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxquery">Query</a>)</code> | RenameTable creates a Query that can be used to rename a table. |
| `dropTable()` | <code>(table: string): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxquery">Query</a>)</code> | DropTable creates a Query that can be used to drop a table. |
| `truncateTable()` | <code>(table: string): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxquery">Query</a>)</code> | TruncateTable creates a Query that can be used to truncate a table. |
| `addColumn()` | <code>(table: string, col: string, typ: string): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxquery">Query</a>)</code> | AddColumn creates a Query that can be used to add a column to a table. |
| `dropColumn()` | <code>(table: string, col: string): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxquery">Query</a>)</code> | DropColumn creates a Query that can be used to drop a column from a table. |
| `renameColumn()` | <code>(table: string, oldName: string, newName: string): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxquery">Query</a>)</code> | RenameColumn creates a Query that can be used to rename a column in a table. |
| `alterColumn()` | <code>(table: string, col: string, typ: string): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxquery">Query</a>)</code> | AlterColumn creates a Query that can be used to change the definition of a table column. |
| `addPrimaryKey()` | <code>(table: string, name: string, ...cols: string[]): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxquery">Query</a>)</code> | AddPrimaryKey creates a Query that can be used to specify primary key(s) for a table. The "name" parameter specifies the name of the primary key constraint. |
| `dropPrimaryKey()` | <code>(table: string, name: string): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxquery">Query</a>)</code> | DropPrimaryKey creates a Query that can be used to remove the named primary key constraint from a table. |
| `addForeignKey()` | <code>(table: string, name: string, cols: Array&lt;string&gt;, refCols: Array&lt;string&gt;, refTable: string, ...options: string[]): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxquery">Query</a>)</code> | AddForeignKey creates a Query that can be used to add a foreign key constraint to a table. The length of cols and refCols must be the same as they refer to the primary and referential columns. The optional "options" parameters will be appended to the SQL statement. They can be used to specify options such as "ON DELETE CASCADE". |
| `dropForeignKey()` | <code>(table: string, name: string): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxquery">Query</a>)</code> | DropForeignKey creates a Query that can be used to remove the named foreign key constraint from a table. |
| `createIndex()` | <code>(table: string, name: string, ...cols: string[]): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxquery">Query</a>)</code> | CreateIndex creates a Query that can be used to create an index for a table. |
| `createUniqueIndex()` | <code>(table: string, name: string, ...cols: string[]): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxquery">Query</a>)</code> | CreateUniqueIndex creates a Query that can be used to create a unique index for a table. |
| `dropIndex()` | <code>(table: string, name: string): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxquery">Query</a>)</code> | DropIndex creates a Query that can be used to remove the named index from a table. |

| `addPrimaryKey()` | <code>(table: string, name: string, ...cols: string[]): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxquery">Query</a>)</code> | AddPrimaryKey creates a Query that can be used to specify primary key(s) for a table. The "name" parameter specifies the name of the primary key constraint. |
| `dropPrimaryKey()` | <code>(table: string, name: string): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxquery">Query</a>)</code> | DropPrimaryKey creates a Query that can be used to remove the named primary key constraint from a table. |
| `addForeignKey()` | <code>(table: string, name: string, cols: Array&lt;string&gt;, refCols: Array&lt;string&gt;, refTable: string, ...options: string[]): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxquery">Query</a>)</code> | AddForeignKey creates a Query that can be used to add a foreign key constraint to a table. The length of cols and refCols must be the same as they refer to the primary and referential columns. The optional "options" parameters will be appended to the SQL statement. They can be used to specify options such as "ON DELETE CASCADE". |
| `dropForeignKey()` | <code>(table: string, name: string): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxquery">Query</a>)</code> | DropForeignKey creates a Query that can be used to remove the named foreign key constraint from a table. |

The parameters to this method should be the list column names to be selected. A column name may have an optional alias name. For example, Select("id", "my_name AS name"). |

## dbx.LogFunc

LogFunc logs a message for each SQL statement being executed.
This method takes one or multiple parameters. If a single parameter
is provided, it will be treated as the log message. If multiple parameters
are provided, they will be passed to fmt.Sprintf() to generate the log message.

## dbx.PerfFunc

PerfFunc is called when a query finishes execution.
The query execution time is passed to this function so that the DB performance
can be profiled. The "ns" parameter gives the number of nanoseconds that the
SQL statement takes to execute, while the "execute" parameter indicates whether
the SQL statement is executed or queried (usually SELECT statements).

## dbx.QueryLogFunc

QueryLogFunc is called each time when performing a SQL query.
The "t" parameter gives the time that the SQL statement takes to execute,
while rows and err are the result of the query.

## dbx.ExecLogFunc

ExecLogFunc is called each time when a SQL statement is executed.
The "t" parameter gives the time that the SQL statement takes to execute,
while result and err refer to the result of the execution.

## dbx.BuilderFunc

BuilderFunc creates a Builder instance using the given DB instance and Executor.

| `context()` | <code>(): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/context#contextcontext">context.Context</a></code> | Context returns the context associated with the DB instance. It returns nil if no context is associated. |
| `db()` | <code>(): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqldb">sql.DB</a>)</code> | DB returns the sql.DB instance encapsulated by dbx.DB. |
| `close()` | <code>(): void</code> | Close closes the database, releasing any open resources. It is rare to Close a DB, as the DB handle is meant to be long-lived and shared between many goroutines. |

| `wrap()` | <code>(sqlTx: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqltx">sql.Tx</a>): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxtx">Tx</a>)</code> | Wrap encapsulates an existing transaction. |
| `transactional()` | <code>(f: (_arg0: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxtx">Tx</a>) =&gt; void): void</code> | Transactional starts a transaction and executes the given function. If the function returns an error, the transaction will be rolled back. Otherwise, the transaction will be committed. |
| `transactionalContext()` | <code>(ctx: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/context#contextcontext">context.Context</a>, opts: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqltxoptions">sql.TxOptions</a>, f: (_arg0: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxtx">Tx</a>) =&gt; void): void</code> | TransactionalContext starts a transaction and executes the given function with the given context and transaction options. If the function returns an error, the transaction will be rolled back. Otherwise, the transaction will be committed. |
| `driverName()` | <code>(): string</code> | DriverName returns the name of the DB driver. |
| `quoteTableName()` | <code>(s: string): string</code> | QuoteTableName quotes the given table name appropriately. If the table name contains DB schema prefix, it will be handled accordingly. This method will do nothing if the table name is already quoted or if it contains parenthesis. |
| `quoteColumnName()` | <code>(s: string): string</code> | QuoteColumnName quotes the given column name appropriately. If the table name contains table name prefix, it will be handled accordingly. This method will do nothing if the column name is already quoted or if it contains parenthesis. |

If the expression contains binding parameters, they will be added to the given Params. |

## dbx.HashExp

HashExp represents a hash expression.

A hash expression is a map whose keys are DB column names which need to be filtered according
to the corresponding values. For example, HashExp{"level": 2, "dept": 10} will generate
the SQL: "level"=2 AND "dept"=10.

HashExp also handles nil values and slice values. For example, HashExp{"level": []interface{}{1, 2}, "dept": nil}
will generate: "level" IN (1, 2) AND "dept" IS NULL.

Has everything <code>{ [key: string]: any }</code> has.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `build()` | <code>(db: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxdb">DB</a>, params: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxparams">Params</a>): string</code> | Build converts an expression into a SQL fragment. |

ExecHookFunc executes before op allowing custom handling like auto fail/retry.

## dbx.AllHookFunc

AllHookFunc executes right before the query populate the row result from All() call (aka. op).

## dbx.Query

Query represents a SQL statement to be executed.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `fieldMapper` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxfieldmapfunc">FieldMapFunc</a></code> | FieldMapper maps struct field names to DB column names. |
| `lastError` | <code>Error</code> | LastError contains the last error (if any) of the query. LastError is cleared by Execute(), Row(), Rows(), One(), and All(). |
| `logFunc` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxlogfunc">LogFunc</a></code> | LogFunc is used to log the SQL statement being executed. |
| `perfFunc` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxperffunc">PerfFunc</a></code> | PerfFunc is used to log the SQL execution time. It is ignored if nil. Deprecated: Please use QueryLogFunc and ExecLogFunc instead. |
| `queryLogFunc` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxquerylogfunc">QueryLogFunc</a></code> | QueryLogFunc is called each time when performing a SQL query that returns data. |
| `execLogFunc` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxexeclogfunc">ExecLogFunc</a></code> | ExecLogFunc is called each time when a SQL statement is executed. |
| `sql()` | <code>(): string</code> | SQL returns the original SQL used to create the query. The actual SQL (RawSQL) being executed is obtained by replacing the named parameter placeholders with anonymous ones. |
| `context()` | <code>(): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/context#contextcontext">context.Context</a></code> | Context returns the context associated with the query. |
| `withContext()` | <code>(ctx: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/context#contextcontext">context.Context</a>): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxquery">Query</a>)</code> | WithContext associates a context with the query. |
| `withExecHook()` | <code>(fn: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxexechookfunc">ExecHookFunc</a>): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxquery">Query</a>)</code> | WithExecHook associates the provided exec hook function with the query. |
| `withOneHook()` | <code>(fn: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxonehookfunc">OneHookFunc</a>): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxquery">Query</a>)</code> | WithOneHook associates the provided hook function with the query, called on q.One(), allowing you to implement custom struct scan based on the One() argument and/or result. |
| `withAllHook()` | <code>(fn: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxallhookfunc">AllHookFunc</a>): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxquery">Query</a>)</code> | WithOneHook associates the provided hook function with the query, called on q.All(), allowing you to implement custom slice scan based on the All() argument and/or result. |
| `params()` | <code>(): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxparams">Params</a></code> | Params returns the parameters to be bound to the SQL statement represented by this query. |
| `prepare()` | <code>(): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxquery">Query</a>)</code> | Prepare creates a prepared statement for later queries or executions. Close() should be called after finishing all queries. |
| `close()` | <code>(): void</code> | Close closes the underlying prepared statement. Close does nothing if the query has not been prepared before. |
| `bind()` | <code>(params: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxparams">Params</a>): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxquery">Query</a>)</code> | Bind sets the parameters that should be bound to the SQL statement. The parameter placeholders in the SQL statement are in the format of "{:ParamName}". |
| `execute()` | <code>(): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlresult">sql.Result</a></code> | Execute executes the SQL statement without retrieving data. |
| `one()` | <code>(a: { }): void</code> | One executes the SQL statement and populates the first row of the result into a struct or NullStringMap. Refer to Rows.ScanStruct() and Rows.ScanMap() for more details on how to specify the variable to be populated. Note that when the query has no rows in the result set, an sql.ErrNoRows will be returned. |
| `all()` | <code>(slice: { }): void</code> | All executes the SQL statement and populates all the resulting rows into a slice of struct or NullStringMap. The slice must be given as a pointer. Each slice element must be either a struct or a NullStringMap. Refer to Rows.ScanStruct() and Rows.ScanMap() for more details on how each slice element can be. If the query returns no row, the slice will be an empty slice (not nil). |
| `row()` | <code>(...a: { }[]): void</code> | Row executes the SQL statement and populates the first row of the result into a list of variables. Note that the number of the variables should match to that of the columns in the query result. Note that when the query has no rows in the result set, an sql.ErrNoRows will be returned. |
| `column()` | <code>(a: { }): void</code> | Column executes the SQL statement and populates the first column of the result into a slice. Note that the parameter must be a pointer to a slice. |
| `rows()` | <code>(): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxrows">Rows</a>)</code> | Rows executes the SQL statement and returns a Rows object to allow retrieving data row by row. |

## dbx.Rows

Has everything <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/sql#sqlrows">sql.Rows</a></code> has.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `scanMap()` | <code>(a: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxnullstringmap">NullStringMap</a>): void</code> | ScanMap populates the current row of data into a NullStringMap. Note that the NullStringMap must not be nil, or it will panic. The NullStringMap will be populated using column names as keys and their values as the corresponding element values. |
| `scanStruct()` | <code>(a: { }): void</code> | ScanStruct populates the current row of data into a struct. The struct must be given as a pointer. |

## dbx.BuildHookFunc

BuildHookFunc defines a callback function that is executed on Query creation.

## dbx.SelectQuery

SelectQuery represents a DB-agnostic SELECT query.
It can be built into a DB-specific query by calling the Build() method.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `fieldMapper` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxfieldmapfunc">FieldMapFunc</a></code> | FieldMapper maps struct field names to DB column names. |
| `tableMapper` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxtablemapfunc">TableMapFunc</a></code> | TableMapper maps structs to DB table names. |
| `withBuildHook()` | <code>(fn: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxbuildhookfunc">BuildHookFunc</a>): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxselectquery">SelectQuery</a>)</code> | WithBuildHook runs the provided hook function with the query created on Build(). |
| `context()` | <code>(): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/context#contextcontext">context.Context</a></code> | Context returns the context associated with the query. |
| `withContext()` | <code>(ctx: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/context#contextcontext">context.Context</a>): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxselectquery">SelectQuery</a>)</code> | WithContext associates a context with the query. |
| `preFragment()` | <code>(fragment: string): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxselectquery">SelectQuery</a>)</code> | PreFragment sets SQL fragment that should be prepended before the select query (e.g. WITH clause). |
| `postFragment()` | <code>(fragment: string): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxselectquery">SelectQuery</a>)</code> | PostFragment sets SQL fragment that should be appended at the end of the main select query. |
| `select()` | <code>(...cols: string[]): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxselectquery">SelectQuery</a>)</code> | Select specifies the columns to be selected. Column names will be automatically quoted. |
| `andSelect()` | <code>(...cols: string[]): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxselectquery">SelectQuery</a>)</code> | AndSelect adds additional columns to be selected. Column names will be automatically quoted. |
| `distinct()` | <code>(v: boolean): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxselectquery">SelectQuery</a>)</code> | Distinct specifies whether to select columns distinctively. By default, distinct is false. |
| `selectOption()` | <code>(option: string): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxselectquery">SelectQuery</a>)</code> | SelectOption specifies additional option that should be append to "SELECT". |
| `from()` | <code>(...tables: string[]): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxselectquery">SelectQuery</a>)</code> | From specifies which tables to select from. Table names will be automatically quoted. |
| `where()` | <code>(e: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxexpression">Expression</a>): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxselectquery">SelectQuery</a>)</code> | Where specifies the WHERE condition. |
| `andWhere()` | <code>(e: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxexpression">Expression</a>): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxselectquery">SelectQuery</a>)</code> | AndWhere concatenates a new WHERE condition with the existing one (if any) using "AND". |
| `orWhere()` | <code>(e: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxexpression">Expression</a>): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxselectquery">SelectQuery</a>)</code> | OrWhere concatenates a new WHERE condition with the existing one (if any) using "OR". |
| `join()` | <code>(typ: string, table: string, on: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxexpression">Expression</a>): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxselectquery">SelectQuery</a>)</code> | Join specifies a JOIN clause. The "typ" parameter specifies the JOIN type (e.g. "INNER JOIN", "LEFT JOIN"). |
| `innerJoin()` | <code>(table: string, on: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxexpression">Expression</a>): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxselectquery">SelectQuery</a>)</code> | InnerJoin specifies an INNER JOIN clause. This is a shortcut method for Join. |
| `leftJoin()` | <code>(table: string, on: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxexpression">Expression</a>): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxselectquery">SelectQuery</a>)</code> | LeftJoin specifies a LEFT JOIN clause. This is a shortcut method for Join. |
| `rightJoin()` | <code>(table: string, on: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxexpression">Expression</a>): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxselectquery">SelectQuery</a>)</code> | RightJoin specifies a RIGHT JOIN clause. This is a shortcut method for Join. |
| `orderBy()` | <code>(...cols: string[]): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxselectquery">SelectQuery</a>)</code> | OrderBy specifies the ORDER BY clause. Column names will be properly quoted. A column name can contain "ASC" or "DESC" to indicate its ordering direction. |
| `andOrderBy()` | <code>(...cols: string[]): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxselectquery">SelectQuery</a>)</code> | AndOrderBy appends additional columns to the existing ORDER BY clause. Column names will be properly quoted. A column name can contain "ASC" or "DESC" to indicate its ordering direction. |
| `groupBy()` | <code>(...cols: string[]): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxselectquery">SelectQuery</a>)</code> | GroupBy specifies the GROUP BY clause. Column names will be properly quoted. |
| `andGroupBy()` | <code>(...cols: string[]): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxselectquery">SelectQuery</a>)</code> | AndGroupBy appends additional columns to the existing GROUP BY clause. Column names will be properly quoted. |
| `having()` | <code>(e: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxexpression">Expression</a>): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxselectquery">SelectQuery</a>)</code> | Having specifies the HAVING clause. |
| `andHaving()` | <code>(e: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxexpression">Expression</a>): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxselectquery">SelectQuery</a>)</code> | AndHaving concatenates a new HAVING condition with the existing one (if any) using "AND". |
| `orHaving()` | <code>(e: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxexpression">Expression</a>): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxselectquery">SelectQuery</a>)</code> | OrHaving concatenates a new HAVING condition with the existing one (if any) using "OR". |
| `union()` | <code>(q: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxquery">Query</a>): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxselectquery">SelectQuery</a>)</code> | Union specifies a UNION clause. |
| `unionAll()` | <code>(q: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxquery">Query</a>): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxselectquery">SelectQuery</a>)</code> | UnionAll specifies a UNION ALL clause. |
| `limit()` | <code>(limit: number): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxselectquery">SelectQuery</a>)</code> | Limit specifies the LIMIT clause. A negative limit means no limit. |
| `offset()` | <code>(offset: number): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxselectquery">SelectQuery</a>)</code> | Offset specifies the OFFSET clause. A negative offset means no offset. |
| `bind()` | <code>(params: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxparams">Params</a>): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxselectquery">SelectQuery</a>)</code> | Bind specifies the parameter values to be bound to the query. |
| `andBind()` | <code>(params: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxparams">Params</a>): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxselectquery">SelectQuery</a>)</code> | AndBind appends additional parameters to be bound to the query. |
| `build()` | <code>(): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxquery">Query</a>)</code> | Build builds the SELECT query and returns an executable Query object. |
| `one()` | <code>(a: { }): void</code> | One executes the SELECT query and populates the first row of the result into the specified variable. |
| `model()` | <code>(pk: { }, model: { }): void</code> | Model selects the row with the specified primary key and populates the model with the row data. |
| `all()` | <code>(slice: { }): void</code> | All executes the SELECT query and populates all rows of the result into a slice. |
| `rows()` | <code>(): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxrows">Rows</a>)</code> | Rows builds and executes the SELECT query and returns a Rows object for data retrieval purpose. This is a shortcut to SelectQuery.Build().Rows() |
| `row()` | <code>(...a: { }[]): void</code> | Row builds and executes the SELECT query and populates the first row of the result into the specified variables. This is a shortcut to SelectQuery.Build().Row() |
| `column()` | <code>(a: { }): void</code> | Column builds and executes the SELECT statement and populates the first column of the result into a slice. Note that the parameter must be a pointer to a slice. This is a shortcut to SelectQuery.Build().Column() |
| `info()` | <code>(): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxqueryinfo">QueryInfo</a>)</code> | Info exports common SelectQuery fields allowing to inspect the current select query options. |
